'''Risa Hayamizu''' (Japanese: '''早水リサ''' ''Hayamizu Risa'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hayamizu was born on February 28, 1975, in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She started her work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|RS}}. In {{aniseries|DP}}, she provided the voice of both [[Zoey]] and {{si|Rhonda}}. Hayamizu is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Arts Vision}}.
